usage: Common word for leafy vegetables or greens in everyday Cantonese; often used when talking about food, markets, and cooking.
Very often appears in compounds like 蔬菜 or before a specific type of vegetable, e.g. 菜心, 生菜.
Can refer to vegetables in general, but in daily speech it may sound a bit more like “greens” than the broad formal English “vegetable.”
Use it naturally in everyday conversation; it is neutral and very common in Hong Kong speech.
